advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Use `ni.get("detail")` (with a fallback) instead of `ni["detail"]` in _lib_reads.py:421 to stay consistent with the defensive `.get("kind")` and avoid a KeyError if a future not_initialized finding lacks `detail`.
evidence: src/rebar/_lib_reads.py:420: `ni = next((i for i in payload["issues"] if i.get("kind") == "not_initialized"), None)`
src/rebar/_lib_reads.py:421: `reason = ni["detail"] if ni else (err.getvalue() or out.getvalue()).strip()`
_transform_json always assigns item["detail"] (structured branch or the `else: item["detail"] = rest`), so no KeyError occurs today — this is a resilience/consistency note, not a live bug.
advisory.finding: In _lib_reads.py the not_initialized reason extraction uses a direct subscript `ni["detail"]` while the immediately preceding line defensively uses `.get("kind")`; if a future producer emits a not_initialized finding without a `detail` key this raises KeyError instead of falling back to the stderr/stdout diagnostic. Safe today because _transform_json always sets `detail`, but the inconsistency is a latent fragility.
advisory.suggested_fix: reason = (ni.get("detail") if ni else None) or (err.getvalue() or out.getvalue()).strip()
